! Title: 真实清单片段(手写摘录,用于兼容性回归)
[Adblock Plus 2.0]
! 纯主机 / 锚点 / 通配 —— 支持
||ads.example.com^
||tracker.example.net^$third-party
||cdn.example.com/ads/pixel.gif
example.com^
*.banner.example.org
*/ads/*.js
@@||good.example.com^
! 选项子集 —— 支持
||metrics.example.com^$script,third-party
||pixel.example.com^$image,~third-party
||api.example.com^$domain=news.example.com|~beta.news.example.com
||must-block.example.com^$important
||doubleclick.net^$badfilter
! 元素规则 —— 支持
example.com##.ad-banner
example.com,news.example.com##.sponsored
example.com,~beta.example.com##.promo
##.global-ad-slot
example.com#@#.ad-banner
@@||news.example.com^$generichide
@@||beta.example.com^$elemhide
! 不支持的选项 —— 必须跳过(绝不能降级成整域拦截)
||redirect.example.com^$redirect=noop.js
||clean.example.com^$removeparam=utm_source
||csp.example.com^$csp=script-src 'self'
||page.example.com^$document
||popup.example.com^$popup
||header.example.com^$removeheader=set-cookie
||unknown.example.com^$totally-unknown-option
! scriptlet / 过程式过滤 —— 跳过
example.com#?#.extended:has(.x)
example.com#$#body { background: none !important; }
example.com#%#//scriptlet('abort-on-property-read', 'ads')
example.com##.x:has-text(Sponsored)
example.com##+js(set-constant, ads, false)
! 非 ABP 格式 —— 识别并明确拒绝
0.0.0.0 telemetry.bad.example
127.0.0.1 metrics.bad.example
address=/dns.bad.example/0.0.0.0

DOMAIN-SUFFIX,clash.bad.example
DOMAIN,clash2.bad.example
